chk_domains_owner.name: chk_domains_owner
chk_domains_owner.value:
(
        (is_default = true AND user_id IS NULL AND hostname = 'n2l.ink')
        OR
        (is_default = false AND user_id IS NOT NULL)
      )

chk_domains_active_verified.name: chk_domains_active_verified
chk_domains_active_verified.value: status <> 'active' OR verified_at IS NOT NULL

chk_link_sync_jobs_counts.name: chk_link_sync_jobs_counts
chk_link_sync_jobs_counts.value:
total_links >= 0
        AND processed_links >= 0
        AND checkpoint_index >= 0
        AND attempts >= 0
